page.overview:
Who is Gaucho?

Gaucho is a competitor in the Steel Ball Run, but becomes lost during the 4th Stage of the race in an orchard outside Cannon City along with three other racers: Johnny Joestar, Gyro Zeppeli and Hot Pants.

Gaucho is a medium-built Spaniard who has shoulder-long dark hair and a horseshoe mustache.

His attire consists of a light shirt and a sleeveless overshirt, a jean and unremarkable boots and gloves, plus a sombrero.

Because of his minor role, not much is known about his personality. He is shown to be very competitive and quick to anger.
